Union of India . Justice Kaul described it as an attempt to "take the case away from him" and that can "only have been done by the Chief Justice himself". This, the book states, "drove a wedge between the Chief Justice and me". items.title: Kerala High Court seeks info from Centre, State on blocking Facebook page of news portal NoCap
items.summary: The Kerala High Court on Monday sought a response from the Union government and the State on whether any order was issued to Facebook directing it to block the page of Malayalam digital news platform 'NoCap' in India [ Hyder Ali K v Union of India & ors ]. Justice Ziyad Rahman AA issued the direction while considering a petition filed by NoCap's Chief Editor, Hyder Ali K, challenging restrictions imposed on news organisation's Facebook page. The plea alleges that this was done without disclosing the reasons for blocking the page or without providing a copy of the blocking order. The Court also sought a response from Meta Platforms, which operates Facebook. " CGC (for Central government) and GP (for State) to get instructions as to whether any orders have been issued to R5 (Meta) for blocking the account, " the Court ordered. The matter has been posted for further consideration on November 5. items.title: Kerala High Court changes its internship policy; only those in final 2 years of LL.B allowed
items.summary: The Kerala High Court has revised its 2026 internship policy, introducing new rules governing applications, entry passes, attendance and the conduct of law students interning at the High Court. The revised policy, titled ' Internship Policy for the High Court of Kerala-2026 (Amended), ' was notified on October 17 and lays down detailed procedures governing internships at the High Court. Clause 6(a) of the policy states that "o nly students in the last two years of their law courses shall be eligible to undergo an internship in the High Court. " The restriction, however, does not apply to internships permitted at the discretion of judges. The policy applies to law students interning under High Court judges and other sections of the Court as well as offices including those of the Advocate General, Additional Solicitor General, Director General of Prosecution, Deputy Solicitor General, Kerala State Legal Services Authority, Mediation Centre, Bar Council of Kerala and other advocates. For internship opportunities under the judges, applications will be processed only after obtaining their consent.
